metric_definition: Mean across complete runs of within-run mean absolute power error (W); every run has equal weight.
scope_limit: Five reserved runs on two calibrated router models. No new-router or identified component-energy law is established.
calibration_note: Separate A/B model parameters from the original development runs; no target-run refit.
timing_contract: Current throughput and packet-size metadata only. Derived packet-rate proxies are not independent measurements; no measured temperature supports a thermal mechanism.
exposure_notice: All reference confirmation targets are exposed. This is a retrospective diagnostic evaluation, not fresh independent confirmation.

uncertainty.reason: Only 5 groups, with system-level dependence; report individual effects without a population confidence interval.

review_criteria.name: Prediction-time information
review_criteria.requirement: Audit raw sample anchors and timestamp/phase cutoffs. Identify every predictor and all calibration; exclude future responses and identifier memorization. Current throughput and packet-size metadata only. Derived packet-rate proxies are not independent measurements; no measured temperature supports a thermal mechanism.

review_criteria.name: Validation and leakage
review_criteria.requirement: Inspect complete training/tuning groups and processing fits. Keep linked units together. Distinguish original held-out evidence from the currently exposed cohort.

review_criteria.name: Executable equations and parameters
review_criteria.requirement: Reproduce submitted predictions; inspect correspondence between written equations and code, all coefficients, learned transformations, hidden calibration and model complexity.

review_criteria.name: Units and scientific interpretation
review_criteria.requirement: Check dimensional consistency and physically plausible signs/regimes; explain identifiability, confounding and why an association is not automatically causal.

review_criteria.name: Controls, uncertainty and failures
review_criteria.requirement: Require falsifying tests, residual checks, sensitivity/ablation evidence and preserved negative results. Use independent groups rather than row-level pseudo-replication.

review_criteria.name: Comparators and practical value
review_criteria.requirement: Compare every frozen baseline under equal information/coverage; justify improvements in physical units and simplicity, not just best-case rows or extra fitted constants.

review_criteria.name: Prior work and novelty
review_criteria.requirement: Disclose source analyses and literature-search records. Separate reproduction from extension; a novelty claim requires independent literature and scientific adjudication.

review_criteria.name: Scope and reproducibility
review_criteria.requirement: State validated systems/conditions, failure modes and out-of-domain limits. Fresh scientific confirmation requires new, unexposed groups with a preregistered protocol.
